summary: Request for delivery of media with new software
body: Arnold Trendler (Head of Security Operating Systems, Block 1): Kyle, hello.We've been instructed by higher-ups to install a new security protocol on the robots. I was informed that you have copies of the disks and new cartridges. Could you tell me when they can arrive? Because I was informed that a critical vulnerability was found in the old version of the software and was asked to urgently install the new version.
